title: Built a drone game for my kid: the phone is the controller, the game runs on the TV. Be honest - could I be onto something here?
author: Due-Wafer1454
selftext: It runs directly on the phone and TV just streams the video in regular browser.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Due-Wafer1454 please update this post with more on how you used AI to build the game. A line saying it was made with AI isn't enough. Share dev details. Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.

comments.author: FragmentedHeap
comments.body: Phone is very poor controller, any ps5/ps4 controller would be better.  More of a gimmick than anything imo, my honest opinion.

comments.author: Saytron3030
comments.body: The cool part about flying a drone is seeing what it sees not the drone... Which is just a flying game? Idk kids like cardboard boxes too

comments.author: AdWilling6074
comments.body: How youve done this? Love it

comments.author: mediamuesli
comments.body: There is missing a Joystick normalel you have 2 and I also think the first person view gives better the drone simulator experience.

comments.author: cagonima69
comments.body: In think the concept is fun, maybe see if you can take the core idea and adapt it to other concepts such as racing etc and then you get something more worthwhile in my opinion. Like this it’s kind of meh on its own

comments.author: ValentDs
comments.body: And where can I download it?

comments.author: OtherwiseMenu1505
comments.body: Da fuck i know? Ask the kid

comments.author: spixt
comments.body:
How's you get that working?  Was there a custom API you built over the WiFi or did Steam or another service give you a remote API? Or did you build a full webservice so you can play with 5g?

Reason I'm asking is because I want to make some educational games for my kid and thought phone would be a better controller for his tiny hands 😂

comments.author: Daytona24
comments.body: Make the phone an actual drone controller where you see what the drone is seeing on the phone! I'll be honest this looks fun.  Make different areas to explore, maybe find hidden stuff, but keep it as a relaxing easy to play game. Nice work!

comments.author: TopIntelligent8802
comments.body: but can't you just use a controller?

comments.author: Outrageous-Story3325
comments.body: add some mission, drop water ballons, on people, take photos of  specific animal, post service mail and packages delevering, etc

comments.author: CriticalDiscipline4
comments.body: Is it fun? Does your kid like playing it? Do you like playing it? If so, then you’re onto something.

comments.author: Project_Asura
comments.body: This could be a cool cinematic viewing adventure by using the drone to experience with your child

comments.author: Idunnoagoodusername2
comments.body: Reading the comments my advice is... don't ask reddit 😂. It looks nice, perfect for a kid which obviously prefers to see the drone, if it was educational I bet it would get downloads
